name: Morningstar Auto Parts
old_description: Morningstar Auto Parts Your Auto Parts Store In Staten Island
about:
Morningstar Auto Parts operates an auto parts store in Staten Island, New York. The business serves the surrounding communities including New Dorp, Great Kills, Eltingville, and several northern New Jersey towns such as Carteret, Linden, and Elizabeth. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The company stocks a range of original equipment and aftermarket components for popular cars and trucks, covering fuel and exhaust systems, radiators and cooling, suspension, and transmission parts. In addition to parts sales, Morningstar provides custom paint services, paint supplies, machine shop work including welding, and hazardous waste removal through partner vendors. The shop also offers counter service, heavy-duty vehicle support, and express courier delivery.

Customers include individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and fleet operators in the New York metropolitan area. The company highlights its ability to locate hard-to-find parts and cites a customer testimonial describing same-day delivery of a part sourced within minutes and priced significantly below dealership quotes.

Morningstar emphasizes fast shipping, in-store pickup, online package tracking, and a 30-day return policy as part of its service promise. The business also promotes manufacturer coupons and rebates, and positions itself as a source for both OEM and high-performance aftermarket upgrades.
